_doc: Committed identity baseline for the shrink-ratchet surfaces in data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json (GHI #1154 item 4). A surface may carry only identities held here or named by a reviewed record under 'authorizations'; a renamed or moved entry is a NEW identity, so a swap that leaves the count unchanged fails. Seeded 2026-10-02 from the live surfaces, as a record of what was accepted on that date. The audit never prunes it: a removed entry may return, a new one may not. An authorization record carries data_file, identity, reason, authorized_by (g0 for the operator) and ruling (the operator's words verbatim, or the GHI). Enforced by src/gzkit/governance/trust_audits/waiver_ratchet.py.
